import asyncio

async def worker(q, results):
    while True:
        item = await q.get()
        if item is None:
            q.task_done()
            return
        index, value = item
        await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
        results.append((index, value * value))
        q.task_done()

async def process(jobs, n_workers):
    q = asyncio.Queue()
    results = []
    workers = [asyncio.create_task(worker(q, results)) for _ in range(n_workers)]
    for i, v in enumerate(jobs):
        await q.put((i, v))
    for _ in range(n_workers):
        await q.put(None)
    await q.join()
    await asyncio.gather(*workers)
    return [value for _, value in sorted(results)]

print(asyncio.run(process([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], 3)))
